posts.title: Waiting for Music.
posts.description: Waiting for Music . The lost art of attentive listening. Countless books have been written about the concept of “Waiting for God”. The way I interpret the idea is rather similar to Wu Wei in Daoism. Essentially, a passive approach is the way to go. Or rather, not go. In fact, don’t go anywhere, just be .
